Specification: This module is a small test-oriented TLA+ specification that exercises shell-command execution and environment-variable access through the IOUtils interface. It declares a single variable x locally, but the main content of the module consists of ASSUME statements checking that external environment variables and IOExec results have expected string and numeric encodings, plus one INSTANCE of another module with a substitution for UpperBound. The spec does not define an init/next-state transition system or temporal correctness properties of its own; instead, it validates I/O behavior and a simple CHOOSE-based conversion from the environment variable B to the number 23.
AssumptionNames:
LET ret == IOExec(<<"/bin/sh", "-c", "echo $SOME_TEST_ENV_VAR">>)
                                        IN /\ ret.stdout = "TLCFTW\n"
                                           /\ ret.exitValue = 0
                                           /\ ret.stderr = ""

LET ret == IOExec(<<"/bin/sh", "-c", "echo $SOME_NESTED_VAR">>)
                                        IN /\ ret.stdout = "SOME_VAL\n"
                                           /\ ret.exitValue = 0
                                           /\ ret.stderr = ""

LET n  == CHOOSE n \in 0..100 : IOEnv.B = ToString(n)
       IN n = 23
